source.document: Vishay document 34681, Figure B, page 2; IHXL2000VZ-3A; value 10 uH uses Figure B

native_format.units: All pad, hole and mechanical coordinates are mil; canvas unit only controls display.
native_format.groupIdNote: Un-grouped primitives use groupId string "0" here to satisfy the published validator schema and matching example; the format primitive prose elsewhere describes a numeric 0. Importer normalization remains to be confirmed.

body_outline_mm.placement: X offset derived from Figure B left-edge-to-terminal callout and lead width. Y offset is provisional, using the center of the tinned area estimated from the terminal-length and tinned-length callouts; verify against the physical part.
body_outline_mm.shape: 50.8 x 50.8 mm rectangular envelope on mechanical layer; corner radii omitted because no radius dimension was supplied.

must_confirm_before_pcb_release: Confirm selected component is Figure B / 10 uH package.
Confirm physical lead pitch, body-to-terminal offsets and body envelope using the received part.
Confirm board-fabricator capability and tolerance for plated 8.0 x 2.7 mm slots and 12 x 9 mm annular copper lands.
Perform physical test fit before releasing PCB fabrication.
not_claimed: Not a Vishay-recommended land pattern; the datasheet provides package dimensions, not this PCB slot/copper pattern.
Not checked by EasyEDA import, DRC, PCB fabrication review, or physical test fit.
